title: 「It is only a matter of time before + clause」表示「某事遲早會發生」
titleZh: 「It is only a matter of time before + clause」表示「某事遲早會發生」
titleEn: It is only a matter of time before + clause

source.file: Sentence Structure 244 - 「It is only a matter of time before + clause」表示「某事遲早會發生」.pdf

formula: It + be + only a matter of time + before + subject + verb

formulas.formula: It + be + only a matter of time + before + subject + verb
It is only a matter of time before + present-tense clause
It was only a matter of time before + past-tense clause
It will / may / could only be a matter of time before + clause
Subject + reporting verb + it is / was only a matter of time before + clause
Is / Was it only a matter of time before + clause?

example: It is only a matter of time before the system fails.
exampleZh: 這個系統失靈只是時間問題。

examples.en: It is only a matter of time before the system fails.
examples.zh: 這個系統失靈只是時間問題。
examples.highlight: It is only a matter of time before the system fails.

examples.en: It was only a matter of time before the truth came out.
examples.zh: 真相大白只是時間問題。
examples.highlight: It was only a matter of time before the truth came out.

examples.en: Experts believe it is only a matter of time before prices rise again.
examples.zh: 專家認為價格再次上升只是時間問題。
examples.highlight: Experts believe it is only a matter of time before prices rise again.

meaning.zh: 表示說話者認為某件事幾乎必定會發生，現在只是在等待它發生。

rules.zh: 核心形式可按時間變為 It is、It was 或 It will only be a matter of time before + clause，但「某事遲早會發生」的意思不變。
rules.en: Use the complete core expression with the appropriate form of be: It is, It was or It will only be a matter of time before + clause.
examples: It is only a matter of time before the battery runs out.

rules.zh: before 後必須接含有自己主語和動詞的完整子句，而不是單獨的 V-ing 或名詞片語。
rules.en: Before must be followed by a complete clause with its own subject and verb, not merely a V-ing form or noun phrase.
examples: Incorrect for this target: before failing

rules.zh: 表達將來事件時，基本現在式句型的 before 子句通常使用現在式，而不是 will。
rules.en: Use the present tense in the before-clause for a future event in the basic present form; do not normally insert will there.
examples: It is only a matter of time before the system fails.

rules.zh: 過去情境通常使用 It was only a matter of time before + past simple，兩部分時態須一致。
rules.en: Keep past time consistent: use It was only a matter of time before + past simple for a past situation.
examples: It was only a matter of time before the roof collapsed.

rules.zh: 這個句型表示強烈預期，不等同只表示可能性的 might。只有原句含有相應不確定程度時才保留情態語氣。
rules.en: The structure expresses a strong expectation, not mere possibility. A sentence with might alone is weaker and is not automatically equivalent.
examples: It is only a matter of time before the damaged wall collapses.

rules.zh: 目標表達不一定放在整句開首；它可放在轉述、問句、條件句或其他背景資料之後。
rules.en: The expression does not have to appear first. It may occur inside a reported statement, question, conditional sentence or another contextual frame.
examples: Everyone knows it is only a matter of time before the secret is discovered.

benefits.zh: 清楚表示事情不只是可能發生，而是有充分理由相信它遲早會發生。
benefits.en: It clearly shows that something is expected to happen sooner or later.

benefits.zh: 用一句簡潔句子表達「尚未發生，但遲早會發生」，縮短較長預測。
benefits.en: It shortens a longer prediction that an event has not happened yet but will eventually happen.

benefits.zh: 當問題持續惡化時，可用來提出清楚而有力的警告。
benefits.en: It is useful for warnings about an outcome that is becoming difficult to avoid.

benefits.zh: 把目前情況與預期結果連接起來，令預測更有組織。
benefits.en: It makes predictions more organised by linking the present situation to its expected result.

benefits.zh: 可自然放入轉述、根據資料的句子或條件句，避免所有答案都以 It 開始。
benefits.en: It can be used inside longer sentences, including reports, evidence-based statements and conditions.
